evidence.quote: AWS makes two SLA commitments for Amazon Aurora: (1) a Multi-AZ SLA that governs each Amazon Aurora cluster deployed across two or more AZs; and (2) a Single-AZ SLA that governs each Amazon Aurora cluster that is deployed to one AZ.
